dialogues.speaker: Thiyya
dialogues.text: No need to thank me, I wasn't praising you.

dialogues.speaker: Thiyya
dialogues.text: It's just an... objective evaluation of your skill.

dialogues.speaker: Thiyya
dialogues.text: Sometimes, the more capable a person is, the more dangerous they are too, right?

dialogues.speaker: Thiyya
dialogues.text: I may just be in charge of logistics, but I can never be too careful.
